jobs.description:
Warranty Engineer - technical expert

At Körber Supply Chain, we are passionate about delivering innovative automation solutions that help our customers optimize their supply chains and stay competitive in a rapidly changing world. To support our continued growth, we are looking for a skilled and customer-focused Warranty Engineer who can combine technical expertise, project management, and customer engagement to ensure the successful handling and resolution of warranty-related issues across our advanced warehouse automation solutions.

Acting as the link between customers, engineering teams, suppliers, and internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in driving customer satisfaction while contributing to the continuous improvement of our products and solutions.

As our Warranty Engineer, you will be responsible for investigating and resolving technical claims related to machine performance, malfunctions, and system reliability. You will perform root cause analyses, evaluate warranty entitlement, coordinate corrective actions, and ensure timely closure of warranty cases. At the same time, you will lead warranty-related projects from initiation to completion, managing timelines, stakeholders, risks, and communication throughout the process.

Success in this role requires close collaboration across functions. You will work alongside colleagues from Engineering, Standardization, Manufacturing, and Customer Service, while also building strong relationships with customers and suppliers. Through your structured and analytical approach, you will help identify opportunities for improvement and ensure that lessons learned are translated into sustainable solutions.

We are looking for a candidate with a degree in Marine Engineering (Maskinmester), Mechanical  Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a similar technical discipline, combined with experience from technical support, warranty management, project management, or related roles within manufacturing, automation, or industrial environments. Solid technical understanding of automation systems involving PLC control systems, electrical equipment, and mechanical components in industrial machines.

We welcome applications from both recent graduates who are eager to learn and develop within the role, as well as experienced professionals who can bring valuable knowledge, insights, and expertise to the team from day one.

As a person, you are analytical, structured, and solution-oriented. You thrive in a collaborative environment and are comfortable communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You have a strong customer focus, take ownership of your responsibilities, and are motivated by solving complex challenges while delivering high-quality results.

At Körber Supply Chain, you will become part of an international and innovative organization where technology, collaboration, and continuous improvement are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a dynamic working environment, opportunities for professional development, and the chance to make a tangible impact on the success of our customers and business.

If you are ready to take on a role where technical expertise meets customer value and project leadership, we would love to hear from you.

Why Join Körber Supply Chain DK?

At Körber Supply Chain, we believe that our people are our greatest asset. That's why we offer a range of attractive employee benefits designed to support your well-being, development, and work-life balance.

Security & Health

In addition to a competitive salary package, you will be enrolled in our pension scheme, which includes health and dental insurance, as well as access to physiotherapy services. You will also be part of our lunch program, where our canteen serves healthy and varied meals every day.

Learning & Development

We are committed to the continuous development of our employees and offer relevant training and development opportunities. Whether your goal is to strengthen your technical expertise, leadership capabilities, or professional skills, we support your growth and long-term career development.

A Strong Community

Our culture is built on collaboration, engagement, and strong relationships. Through our active employee association and various company events, you'll have plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues. Activities include Friday bars, Christmas parties, our annual ski trip, cultural events, and much more.

Körber – Conquer Supply Chain Complexity

At Körber, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We celebrate diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion or belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Apply now and join our team!

Ready for your next step? Click on ‘Apply now’ to get started right away! As long as the position is advertised, you can apply at any time.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status. You can find out more about our culture here Culture at Körber - it's worth taking a look!

If you have any questions or technical problems, please send us an e-mail to jobs@koerber.com. Mette Maria Holmegaard Nielsen is the responsible person for this job advertisement. We work with permanent partners and therefore ask recruitment consultants to refrain from contacting us by e-mail or telephone.

At Körber, we think long term and pursue objectives that apply across all of our business areas. In line with our vision of “Market Leadership through Technology Leadership,” we have defined our “Life 2035” goals for the next decade to ensure that Körber becomes the leading partner in our industries—Life Science, Supply Chain, and High-Tech Manufacturing—by 2035.Life 2035 is built on four pillars that define how we embrace our shaping role: Leadership, Innovation, Findependence, and Empowerment. Sustainably profitable growth and financial independence form the foundation for achieving our ambitious financial targets for the next decade. By 2035, we aim to achieve global revenues of €10 billion. You can find more at https://www.koerber.com/en/about-us/what-drives-us

Körber is a global technology company for intelligent manufacturing and supply chain solutions. As a reliable innovation partner, Körber turns entrepreneurial thinking into customer success by providing leading technology to fuel what’s next – from end-to-end pharma production and advanced supply chain solutions to high-tech machinery and process equipment. Körber combines deep domain expertise with integrated hardware, software, and digital services, to help customers take the next step.

Do you want to work close to clients and help build one of Denmark’s best Business Central partners?

Kolding harbour with a tall ship, warehouses and reflections in the water — a few metres from DynaFlow’s offices

Our offices sit a few metres from the waterfront in Kolding.

At DynaFlow we are looking for an experienced Senior Business Central Consultant to join a team that knows the Business Central market from the inside. We bring many years of experience from larger consultancies, where we have led teams, built business and delivered complex client projects — and we use that experience to create confidence, clarity and solutions that hold up in practice.

About DynaFlow

At DynaFlow we believe in a different way of being a consultancy. Good advice does not start with technology, PowerPoints or processes — it starts with people, business and understanding.

We specialise in Dynamics NAV and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and have gathered more than 50 years of combined experience with solutions across industries, countries and organisations. Our clients range from large international groups to small and medium-sized businesses. For us, quality matters more than quantity, and we never leave a client stranded on the quayside.

About the role

As a Senior Business Central Consultant you take a central role in our work with clients. You become a trusted advisor and a strong professional sparring partner — close to the business and close to the people behind it.

You will work with advisory, solution design, implementation, support, optimisation and project management. Some tasks are about creating structure and momentum in complex ERP landscapes. Others are about making everyday work run more smoothly for the client. What they all have in common is that the solution has to make sense both now and in the longer term.

Your tasks will include:

• Analysing and mapping clients’ business processes

• Advising on the best possible use of Business Central

• Implementing, upgrading and developing Business Central solutions

• Operations, support, troubleshooting and ongoing sparring

• Project management and coordination across business, internal resources and vendors

• Close client relationships with a focus on presence and continuity

We imagine that you

• Have solid experience with Business Central/NAV, ideally at least 5 years

• Have strong business understanding from implementation, operations or advisory

• Can create clarity in complex solutions and turn needs into practical results

• Take independent ownership of clients, tasks and momentum

• Communicate clearly with management, key users, developers and partners alike

• Want to work closely with clients and build long-term relationships

• Thrive with freedom under responsibility, and bring humour and team spirit

• Speak and write fluent Danish, and preferably English

What we offer

• An important role in an ambitious, growing Business Central company

• The chance to help build one of the strongest Business Central environments in the country

• Plenty of freedom, flexibility and responsibility day to day

• Client relationships where presence and continuity actually matter

• Work for both international groups and small/medium-sized businesses

• Skilled colleagues with deep consulting and business experience

• The option to work from home and flexible working hours

• Canteen lunch scheme

• Pension with a health-insurance scheme

• Paid phone and internet

• Premium offices a few metres from the waterfront in Kolding

How to apply

Send your application and CV to kontakt@dynaflow.dk. We invite candidates to interviews on a rolling basis, so don’t hesitate to reach out.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to call Chris or Rasmus. We look forward to hearing from you.

Chris Erik Jensen

+45 36 20 70 13cej@dynaflow.dk

Rasmus Torpe

+45 30 23 14 47rto@dynaflow.dk

Do you want to use your skills in pioneering technology in a highly dynamic, ambitious environment with broad variety of exciting projects? In Welltec, cutting-edge technology and global development are high on the agenda, and we are looking for colleagues within mechanical engineering to take this journey to the next level.

A world-class company

Welltec® is an international oilfield service company and a leading specialist partner to the energy industry.

Our values are to be Pioneering, Visionary, Dedicated, and Agile.

We develop and manufacture precision-controlled technologies which provide the most unique and advanced Completion and Intervention solutions, which assist our clients in maximizing recovery from their assets.

We always look to the future, utilizing our intelligence, imagination and expertise to create new opportunities. We have won several industry awards for innovative thinking. We are enjoying constant growth worldwide through the wide adoption of our cutting-edge solutions.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we are active and train our employees to operate our state-of-the-art technologies to provide services to our high-profile clients in the region.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employees come with very different backgrounds but with a common wish to collaborate and succeed.

The department

At Welltec, you will join our mechanical department situated in our completions Design & Engineering (D&E) function which currently consists of over 20 colleagues worldwide with various educational backgrounds and nationalities. In D&E we closely together - in order to get a holistic approach to our products and tools and to benefit from each other’s knowledge and expertise. In D&E, the work environment is informal, creative and fun but at times it can be complex, challenging, and fast-paced.

The team that you will join is responsible for the development and maintenance of Welltec’s proprietary metal expandable packer technology and other innovative technologies which we constantly introduce to the market through our global footprint.

The position

As a mechanical engineer within Design and Engineering (D&E) you will have the possibility to be innovative and create technology solutions from the idea phase to the commercial implementation. The main task is to develop new technologies where your focus will be development of mechanical systems. You will, together with the team, be part of conceptualization of products and detailed design development both for prototypes and commercial design. You will work in an environment where you will be able to develop your skills and where innovation is a key focus and you will be part of an agile business where your input will be heard. Travelling for exhibition and conferences related to the energy market can be expected to a smaller extent.

As our new Mechanical Engineer, you will:

• Be part of concept phase as team and have ownership of design and manufacturing package

• Conduct prototype assembly and function testing/troubleshooting

Ensure collaboration with relevant teams and stakeholders within the organisation

• Cooperate with sub-contractors

• Take ownership of schedules and delivery times

• Challenge the business with new ideas and concepts

• Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of the Design and Engineering (D&E) department

Your tasks will include:

• Work on technical projects through all development phases

• Working in teams on development projects with both own and shared tasks

• Conceptualization and feasibility studies

• Design review guided by DFM, FMEA principles and robust design thinking

• 3D mechanical design

• Trouble shooting on both existing solutions as well as new solutions under development

• Provide your guidance and input in your specific expert areas across the whole organization

The candidate

You are proactive in your daily tasks and have an analytical and critical approach to problem solving. You have a quick, creative mind with a natural understanding of complex concepts and systems. The ideal candidate is someone who gets excited by technology and open-ended challenges as described above. In order to perform well in this role, you should also have the following qualifications or similar competencies:

The preferred candidate has the following profile:

• Mechanical Engineer B.Sc, M.Sc. or similar background

• Experience from oilfield, energy sector, hydraulics, precision mechanics, electro mechanical systems, mechatronics or similar is a plus

• Takes ownership of tasks and projects – enjoys broad responsibility

• Agile Project Management skills

• Is an experienced CAD user in Catia Software or similar system

• Is experienced in the use of FEA simulations in ANSYS or similar system

• Most importantly – commitment to learn the skills not yet acquired but required for the job

What we offer

Working with Welltec® means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting and rewarding, and it is a varied place to work. Welltec® is an equal opportunity employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate. Also, Welltec® has a competitive compensation package.

The process

If you are interested in the position submit your resume and cover letter online via the link below.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply soon if you believe you fit the role.

Are you an experienced power trader who enjoys making decisions in fast-moving markets? Would you like to take responsibility for your own trades while working alongside colleagues who share your interest in intraday power trading?

Join our IDE Proprietary Trading team at Norlys Energy Trading in Aalborg. Here, you will use your trading experience to identify opportunities, act on market developments, and contribute to the team's trading activities.

Your team and role

You will join a team of experienced traders working in the intraday power market. The role combines market analysis, trade execution, and risk management with the development of trading strategies.

The desk operates around the clock, and you will be part of our 24/7 shift rotation. You will work independently on trading decisions while exchanging market insights and ideas with colleagues across shifts.

Your key responsibilities

• Analyse market data and price movements to identify trading opportunities.

• Develop and execute intraday trading strategies.

• Monitor positions, manage risk, and respond to changing market conditions.

• Collaborate with traders, analysts and quantitative teams to challenge market views, share insights, and improve trading strategies and decision-making.

• Contribute to improving trading tools, models and processes in collaboration with relevant teams to strengthen analytical capabilities and trading efficiency.

• Coordinate with colleagues across shifts to ensure continuity in trading activities.

• Maintain relationships with relevant market participants and stakeholders.

You'll be joining a desk where different perspectives and trading ideas are part of the conversation. There's room to share your experience, challenge ideas and learn from the people around you.

Jacob Goth

Manager, Proprietary Trading

What we are looking for

We are looking for an experienced trader who combines sound market judgement with the ability to act independently and contribute to a team.

You bring:

• Experience in energy trading, preferably within intraday power.

• Strong analytical skills and a solid understanding of trading strategies and risk management.

• The ability to make well-founded decisions under pressure.

• Good communication skills and an interest in sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• A relevant degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering or a related field.

You should be comfortable working in a 24/7 shift rotation and ready to apply your trading experience from an early stage.

What we offer

You will become part of a specialist trading environment where colleagues share market knowledge, discuss trading ideas, and learn from each other's experience. With responsibility for your own trading activities and opportunities to contribute to strategy development, you will have room to put your expertise to work.

Beyond the trading desk, you will be part of Norlys Energy Trading's wider professional and social community, including an active staff association that brings colleagues together across teams.

The position is permanent, full-time and based at our office in Aalborg, with an expected start date of 1 February 2027.

Interested?

If the role sounds like a good match for your experience, we'd like to hear from you.

Want to know more?

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions about this opportunity

Jacob Goth

Manager, Proprietary Trading

jgo@norlysenergytrading.com

jobs.occupation: Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026 – Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU), Copenhagen, Denmark
jobs.description:
The Position:

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is seeking candidates for its newly established Supply Chain Internship Roster 2026. These internship opportunities are on-site at SCMU’s office in the UN City headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

SCMU offers specialized functional streams aligned with its operational needs, including:

• Data & Analytics

• Logistics & Supply Chain

• Procurement & Business

• Humanitarian Supplies

• Supply Chain & Customer Service

• Governance, Risk & Compliance

• Communications

• Human Resources

• Information and Communications Technology (ICT)

• Administration & Business

To ensure effective team integration and maximize the value of the internship, candidates must be logistically and financially prepared to undertake full-time, on-site work in Copenhagen for the duration of the internship.

How you can make a difference:

UNFPA is the lead UN agency for delivering a world where every pregnancy is wanted, every childbirth is safe and every young person's potential is fulfilled.  UNFPA’s strategic plan (2026-2029), reaffirms the relevance of the current strategic direction of UNFPA and focuses on three transformative results: to end preventable maternal deaths; end unmet need for family planning; and end gender-based violence and harmful practices. These results capture our strategic commitments on accelerating progress towards realizing the ICPD and SDGs in the Decade of Action leading up to 2030. Our strategic plan calls upon UN Member States, organizations and individuals to “build forward better”, while addressing the negative impacts of the Covid-19 pandemic on women’s and girls’ access to sexual and reproductive health and reproductive rights, recover lost gains and realize our goals.

The UNFPA Supply Chain Management Unit (SCMU) is self-funded and was made operational in January 2022. It is tasked with ensuring that UNFPA is able to effectively and efficiently support the delivery of life-saving reproductive health products and other programme supplies to the end user when and where they are needed. To achieve this, it is important to strengthen the capacity of governments and implementing partners to ensure coordination, end-to-end visibility and accountability on all supply chain and logistics management related activities, in particular for programme supplies, across all UNFPA programmes.

In a world where fundamental human rights are at risk, we need principled and ethical staff, who embody these international norms and standards, and who will defend them courageously and with full conviction.

UNFPA is seeking candidates that transform, inspire and deliver high impact and sustained results; we need staff who are transparent, exceptional in how they manage the resources entrusted to them and who commit to deliver excellence in programme results.

Eligibility:

Educational requirements

a. Be enrolled in a first university degree programme (such as bachelor’s degree or equivalent) and have completed one full academic year;

b. Be enrolled in a postgraduate degree programme (such as master’s programme or higher);

c. Have recently graduated with a university degree as defined above and, if selected, must start the internship within one-year of graduation; or

d. Be enrolled in a postgraduate professional trainee programme and undertake the internship as part of this programme.

Other eligibility requirements

e. Demonstrate interest in the field of development;

f.  Demonstrate written and spoken proficiency in at least one of the working languages of the United Nations (English or French) and fluency in the official language (Arabic, Chinese, English, French, Russian or Spanish) of the UNFPA office; and

g. Demonstrate ability to adapt to new environments and to establish and maintain good working relations with individuals of different cultural backgrounds.

An individual whose father, mother, son, daughter, brother or sister is a UNFPA staff member is not eligible for an internship with UNFPA.

Required Competencies:

Values:

• Exemplifying integrity,

• Demonstrating commitment to UNFPA and the UN system,

• Embracing cultural diversity,

• Embracing change

Core Competencies:

• Achieving results,

• Being accountable,

• Developing and applying professional expertise/business acumen,

• Thinking analytically and strategically,

• Working in teams/managing ourselves and our relationships,

Financial Support:

Interns who do not receive financial support from an outside party (such as an academic institution, university, government) are eligible to receive a stipend as a contribution towards living expenses. The stipend is based on the intern’s agreed place of work, which may be different from the duty station of the hiring office in cases of remote arrangements. The stipend is normally paid in local currency at the end of each month.

UNFPA Work Environment:

UNFPA provides a work environment that reflects the values of gender equality, diversity, integrity and healthy work-life balance. We are committed to ensuring gender parity in the organization and therefore encourage women to apply. Individuals from the LGBTQIA+ community, minority ethnic groups, indigenous populations, persons with disabilities, and other underrepresented groups are highly encouraged to apply. Reasonable accommodation may be provided to applicants with disabilities upon request, to support their participation in the recruitment process. UNFPA promotes equal opportunities in terms of appointment, training, compensation and selection for all regardless of personal characteristics and dimensions of diversity. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion is at the heart of UNFPA's workforce - click here to learn more.

Disclaimer:

UNFPA does not charge any application, processing, training, interviewing, testing or other fee in connection with the application or recruitment process and does not concern itself with information on applicants' bank accounts.

Strategy and business development

Innovation & New Ventures Lead

Imagine a future where you build entirely new businesses that accelerate the green transition and unlock new sources of value.

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll originate and build new ventures from the ground up, turning bold ideas into scalable businesses. You’ll shape opportunities, validate them with the market, and drive early commercialisation, working across functions and leveraging the strength of a global organisation.

Welcome to Ventures & Open Innovation

You’ll be part of a team focused on identifying and scaling transformational opportunities, where you together with your colleagues will explore new markets, business models, and technologies. You’ll collaborate closely across engineering, commercial, and business development functions to bring new ideas to life. As a team, we support each other, challenge ideas constructively, and work with curiosity and ownership to turn ambition into impact.

You’ll play an important role in:

• 
originating new business opportunities by identifying white spaces and shaping opportunity areas

• 
leading end-to-end venture building from ideation through validation to early commercialisation

• 
designing and testing business models through structured experimentation and rapid learning

• 
collaborating with internal stakeholders to unlock capabilities and move opportunities forward

• 
translating technical assets and capabilities into new commercial propositions

• 
contributing to innovation strategy and portfolio prioritisation.

To succeed in the role, you:

• 
have hands-on experience building new businesses or ventures from concept to launch

• 
bring a strong commercial mindset, focusing on customers, value creation, and revenue models

• 
are comfortable working across ambiguity and can create structure and direction independently

•

communicate clearly and persuasively, building alignment around new ideas.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr62,160.00- kr93,240.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Imagine a future with Ørsted

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

**About Ørsted

**

• We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.

• Our vision is to create a world that runs entirely on green energy.

• We built the world’s first offshore wind farm, Vindeby in Denmark, in 1991, and completed the world’s largest, Hornsea 2 in the UK, in 2022.

• We were founded in Denmark in 2006 and now have approximately 8,000 employees, working in 15 countries and counting.

An inclusive team

At Ørsted, we strive to be an inclusive workplace where you’re respected for who you are, valued for the unique perspectives you bring, and rewarded fairly for what you achieve. We want all employees to have the same opportunities for impact and growth, no matter their age, race, ethnicity, place of birth, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.

jobs.occupation: System Manager, AC Skid – BESS (Medium Voltage Containerized Systems)
jobs.description:
System Manager, AC Skid – BESS (Medium Voltage Containerized Systems)

Shape the backbone of the energy transition

Are you passionate about building reliable, future-ready energy systems?

Do you enjoy working at the intersection of electrical engineering, system integration, and real-world impact?

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark

Responsibilities

Serve as the overall system‑responsible owner for the AC Skid, covering electrical/functional architecture, safety, quality, and lifecycle performance.

Lead supplier selection, qualification, and governance for the mechanical Skid design, ensuring alignment with system requirements, standards, and cost targets.

Own the technical selection and specification of:

• MV transformer

• RMU

• PCS (in house designed converter integration and interfaces

Ensure correct electrical and functional integration of all subsystems:

• MV transformer – RMU – PCS

• Grounding/earthing

• Cooling and auxiliary power

• Cabling, interlocks, protections, and monitoring

Review and validate supplier designs for the mechanical skid

Ensure compliance with relevant standards:

• MV equipment (IEC/ANSI)

• Transformer and switchgear safety

• Environmental, mechanical, and fire safety

Review supplier documentation, test results, FAT reports, and qualification data.

Drive quality and cost optimization, ensuring a price‑competitive and high‑quality AC Skid product for the BESS platform.

Support customer clarification and quotation phases, ensuring:

• Technical feasibility

• Clear interpretation of customer requirements

• Alignment between project needs and AC Skid capabilities

Collaborate cross‑functionally with electrical, mechanical, controls, product, procurement, and quality teams to ensure seamless AC Skid integration.

Our requirements

Must‑haves:

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Energy Engineering, or similar.

Strong understanding of:

• MV transformers, RMUs, switchgear, and MV safety

• Grid‑connected PCS/power converters

• MV protection, grounding/earthing, and interlocking

• Cooling and auxiliary systems

Experience working with suppliers on:

• Detailed mechanical design reviews

• Documentation review and compliance checks

• Quality and cost evaluations

Ability to support technical clarifications during pre‑sales and quotation phases.

Nice‑to‑haves:

Experience with AC Skids, E‑houses, containerized MV designs, or BESS systems.

Knowledge of grid code requirements for MV‑connected BESS or hybrid power plants.

Familiarity with DFMEA, FAT processes, and utility compliance documentation.

Background in system engineering or product ownership roles.

Location

This role can be based in our offices in Ikast or Hammel, with flexibility for hybrid work.

Ready to Grow Your Impact?

If you’re excited by this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now! Send us your resume in English and help us build the energy systems of tomorrow.

Interviews will be scheduled on an ongoing basis.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Our roles cover multiple functions, locations, and disciplines, providing diverse career paths across the business. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Karen Lim  +45 4194 6883

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

jobs.occupation: System Manager, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)
jobs.description:
Vacancy description

System Manager, Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)

Own the system. Shape the solution. Enable the energy transition.

Are you motivated by bringing complex energy systems together into one seamless, high-performing solution?

Do you enjoy working across technologies, teams, and disciplines to deliver real-world impact?

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark

Responsibilities

Act as the overall system‑responsible owner of the entire BESS solution/product.

Define and maintain the system architecture, ensuring seamless integration of:

• PCS (Power Conversion System)

• Battery DC Block

• AC Skid

• EMS & Hybrid Power Plant Controller (HPPC)

• Grid interconnection & compliance

Ensure subsystem interfaces are clearly defined, robust, and fully aligned across electrical, control, mechanical, and communication domains.

Collaborate closely with other System Managers to deliver a high‑quality, reliable, safe, and easy‑to-install BESS platform.

jobs.description:
As Head of Commercial Products at Impact Fund Denmark, you will turn investment ideas and investor requirements into commercially viable funds and other investment products. You will build the financial models and fund structures that enable Impact Fund Denmark to attract additional private capital for investments in developing and emerging markets.

You will take responsibility for financial structuring and product development, combining hands-on modelling with a visible role in investor discussions. Working closely with the Head of Investor Relations, you will explain product economics, support fundraising and contribute technical expertise to the ongoing investor dialogue for existing funds.

The role is part of Legal, Compliance and Commercial (LCC), led by Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer. LCC brings together Legal Corporate, Legal Transactions, Compliance (Non-Financial Risk), and Sales and Investor Relations and consists of around 15 colleagues across Copenhagen and IFDK’s international locations.

You will work in a highly collaborative environment, with close interaction across Investor Relations, Legal, Risk and the wider investment organisation. The team values openness, constructive challenge and strong professional collaboration. You will have considerable ownership of your area while drawing on specialist expertise from colleagues across LCC, Investment, Finance, Risk, Valuation and Strategy & Business Development.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• 
Design and structure investment products, including tranches with different risk and return profiles, risk-sharing arrangements and guarantees.

• 
Build and challenge financial models using cash-flow analysis, scenarios and simulations, including Monte Carlo methods, to assess outcomes for investors and IFDK.

• 
Assess how funds and products work together, including risk allocation and the implications of different investment and guarantee structures.

• 
Develop fee and pricing models that reflect the economics of each product and the resources required to manage it.

• 
Develop investor and sales materials and present products alongside the Head of Investor Relations, explaining structures, risks and returns and answering product-specific questions in investor due diligence.

• 
Contribute financial analysis to information memoranda and ongoing investor reporting, and participate in Limited Partner Advisory Committee (LPAC) meetings and other investor fora for existing funds.

• 
Work with Investment, Finance, Legal, Risk and Valuation colleagues to translate investor and guarantee requirements into clear responsibilities and processes throughout fund and product lifecycles.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

• 
A consistent approach to financial modelling and clear investor materials supports product design, fundraising and ongoing investor dialogue.

• 
Structuring and pricing options for priority products have been assessed, with clear recommendations on risk allocation and economics.

• 
Responsibilities and handovers for key investor and guarantee requirements are agreed with the relevant teams.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You bring substantial experience in financial structuring and investment products, with the commercial judgement and credibility to take ownership and engage directly with institutional and other private investors. You have:

• 
A relevant master’s degree in finance, economics or a related discipline with a strong quantitative foundation.

• 
Experience personally building financial models and developing or structuring investment products.

• 
A strong understanding of risk, return, cash flows and how financial structures allocate outcomes between different investors.

• 
Experience working with institutional investors, supporting institutional clients or working on the investment side of a pension company.

• 
Experience presenting complex financial topics to investors or institutional clients, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations and respond confidently to technical questions.

• 
Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

You combine technical depth with commercial judgement, take ownership of detailed work and collaborate effectively across specialist functions. Experience with illiquid assets or private-market fund structures would be an advantage.

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

Based in Copenhagen, you will report directly to Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer, and work closely with the Head of Investor Relations. You will have analytical support from Strategy & Business Development for product development and investor-related work.

WHY JOIN US

You will shape how IFDK combines institutional investor requirements, financial returns and impact. The role offers ownership of product development, direct exposure to investors and broad collaboration across IFDK, with the opportunity to see your work through from financial design to fundraising and ongoing investor reporting.

PRACTICAL DETAILS

Location: Copenhagen | Position: Full-time | Start date: By agreement

Please apply through IFDK’s recruitment platform with your CV and a short application explaining your interest in the role and relevant experience.

jobs.occupation: Content Creator to DAMM Cellular Systems A/S
jobs.description:
Content Creator

Find the interesting. Make it understandable. Get it seen.

DAMM Cellular Systems builds communication systems for organisations worldwide that depend on them when communication matters most - from offshore installations and mines to airports and emergency response teams.

We're a technical company with deep expertise, customers operating in high-stakes environments, and an industry moving fast. There are plenty of stories and insights worth sharing. We need someone who can recognise what matters, find the right angle and turn it into content that reaches the people we want to reach.

This is not a traditional content writing role.

Writing is at the heart of it. But writing in isolation is no longer enough.

Today, how content gets discovered is just as important as what it says. Search engines, AI and social platforms are changing how people find and consume information. We need someone who understands these shifts and knows how to make our content more visible, relevant and effective - so it works for us, not the other way around.

What you'll do.

Understand our customers and uncover opportunities

Work closely with our sales teams and partners to understand customer needs, challenges and buying motivations. Draw on engineers and technical specialists to understand how our solutions deliver value. Identify stories, insights and opportunities worth communicating.

Bring our key messages to life

Understand DAMM's positioning, communication priorities, industries and target audiences. Find fresh ways to consistently reinforce our key messages, translate technical capabilities into meaningful customer benefits and communicate what makes DAMM different - without simply repeating ourselves.

Create content that matters

Turn customer insights, expertise, stories and proof points into clear, engaging content for our website, LinkedIn, newsletters and campaigns. Create articles, case studies, thought leadership content, short videos and podcast teasers. Support outreach activities.

Design for discovery

Understand how search, AI, social algorithms and emerging platforms influence what gets found, read and shared. Use that knowledge to shape content from the outset - how it's framed, structured, published and distributed.

Improve what works

Use data, feedback and digital tools to refine content and experiment with new approaches. Find smarter ways to research, create, repurpose content and improve workflows.

What we're looking for

You don't need a traditional background or a particular number of years on your CV. What matters is strong writing, editorial judgement, commercial awareness and curiosity about technology and digital communication.

• Experience creating content for professional audiences, ideally within B2B or technical industries.
• Excellent English writing and editing skills, with the ability to make complex subjects clear, relevant and engaging.
• An understanding of how content gets discovered and performs across digital channels - what makes people stop, read, watch or click.
• Confidence using digital tools and an interest in search and emerging technologies.
• The ability to adapt messages and content for different audiences, industries and formats.
• A proactive, curious mindset and the confidence to ask questions and take initiative.
• Experience creating or editing short-form video is an advantage.
 What you'll be part of

You'll join a small marketing team at our headquarters in Sønderborg, working closely with the Head of Marketing and colleagues across the business.

DAMM has around 80 colleagues representing more than 15 cultures, with teams and partners around the world. We’re an international, flat and team-oriented organisation where people take responsibility for their work, bring their own areas of expertise and work together towards a common goal.

What we offer

• The opportunity to shape how an international technology company communicates.
• A varied role combining writing, creativity, technology and digital communication.
• A small team where your work is visible and your ideas can make a difference.
• Health insurance, a lunch scheme, and social and sporting activities.
The position is based at our office in Sønderborg, Denmark.

How to apply

Forget the traditional cover letter.

Send us your CV and a short application answering two questions:

• What caught your attention about this role, and what would you bring to it?
• Share a piece of writing you're particularly proud of. What makes it work, and why?
Please include examples of your work.

We'd also love to see a short video (around 60 seconds) introducing yourself. Your phone is fine, and no editing is needed. It's completely optional, but it's a nice way for us to get a feel for you.

If you have questions about the role, contact: Lone Hansen, Head of Marketing, at +45 2986 7350.

Summary: Overall Job Purpose

As a Bra Innovation Designer, you will lead the creative development of innovative bra products across our lingerie collections, with a particular focus on moulded cup technologies, new constructions, materials and functional design solutions.

You will combine a strong fashion sensibility with specialist knowledge of bra design, translating customer needs, market insights and emerging textile technologies into commercially relevant products that deliver CHANGE's Perfect Fit philosophy.

Working across our two annual fashion collections and ongoing product development initiatives, you will drive new product concepts from initial research and design through prototyping, sample development and production readiness. You will collaborate closely with Technical Design, Production, Planning and our manufacturing partners in China to develop products that balance innovation, aesthetics, comfort, support, quality and commercial viability.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

·         Research emerging trends, bra innovations, competitor products, textile technologies and customer needs to identify new product development opportunities.

·         Lead the design and development of innovative bra concepts, including moulded cup bras, seamless and bonded constructions, wireless solutions and new support technologies.

·         Explore moulding techniques, foam and spacer materials, cup shapes, pad and wire solutions, innovative fabrics, elastics and construction methods in collaboration with Technical Design, Production and suppliers.

·         Develop new silhouettes and design solutions that enhance fit, comfort, support and aesthetics across CHANGE’s extensive size range, including larger cup sizes.

·         Create detailed design sketches, technical drawings, concept presentations and collection overviews using Adobe Creative Suite.

·         Initiate raw material research, sourcing and development with suppliers, including new material technologies and alternative sourcing opportunities.

·         Work closely with Technical Design on prototype fittings, construction development, material performance and product refinement, supporting the achievement of approved fit and quality standards.

·         Collaborate with manufacturing partners in China to develop prototypes, evaluate new manufacturing capabilities and translate innovative concepts into commercially viable products.

·         Assess target costs, manufacturing feasibility and design-to-cost opportunities to achieve category margin objectives.

·         Create and maintain accurate design information in PLM, including sketches, materials, trims, colorways, design BOM components and development updates.

·         Support product commercialization through product descriptions, key product features, innovation storytelling and collaboration with Marketing.

·         Contribute to continuous improvement of bra design standards, product performance and the development of new product categories.

KPIs

·         On-Time Milestone Delivery: Percentage of assigned design and innovation deliverables completed within agreed collection deadlines.

·         Product Innovation: Delivery of approved new bra concepts, moulded cup solutions, materials and construction innovations against agreed development objectives.

·         First-Time Sample Accuracy: Percentage of initial samples meeting approved design specifications without significant aesthetic or construction-related design corrections.

·         Design Cost Compliance: Percentage of developed styles meeting target FOB costs and category margin objectives.

·         PLM Data Accuracy & Completeness

·         Commercial Performance: Performance of launched innovation products against agreed sales, sell-through and category objectives.

Ideal Profile

You are an experienced and technically curious designer with a genuine passion for lingerie, product innovation and the relationship between design, fit and function.

You bring specialist knowledge of bra construction and moulded cup products, together with a strong understanding of textile materials, manufacturing processes and emerging technologies. You enjoy exploring new solutions, challenging existing product constructions and translating complex technical possibilities into desirable, commercially relevant designs.

You are hands-on, proactive and detail-oriented, with the confidence to drive development projects independently while collaborating closely with technical specialists, suppliers and cross-functional teams.

You combine creativity with commercial awareness and understand how innovative product design can strengthen CHANGE’s positioning in fit, inclusivity and product expertise.

Qualifications

·         Relevant higher education in Fashion Design, Textile Design, or Contour Fashion.

·         Minimum 5 years of professional experience in fashion and textiles, with specialized experience in bra design and intimate apparel product development.

·         Demonstrated experience developing moulded cup bras, including knowledge of cup construction, moulding processes, materials and manufacturing requirements.

·         Strong understanding of bra construction, fit, support, sizing, grading considerations and performance requirements.

·         Knowledge of innovative textile materials, foam, spacer fabrics, bonded and seamless technologies and other functional lingerie constructions.

·         Proven experience managing product development from initial concept through prototyping, sample approval and production readiness.

·         Strong design skills with proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite

·         Experience working with PLM systems and maintaining accurate product development information.

·         Understanding of garment costing, manufacturing feasibility and commercial product development.

·         Experience collaborating with international suppliers and production partners, preferably in Asia.

·         Strong communication, presentation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple development projects and deadlines.

·   Fluent in written and spoken English. Mandarin fluency is a plus

jobs.occupation: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

• 
compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

• 
formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

• 
experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

• 
technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

• 
approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

• 
Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

• 
Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

• 
Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

• 
Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

• 
Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

• 
Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

• 
Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

• 
Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

• 
Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

• 
Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

• 
Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

• 
A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

• 
A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

• 
The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

• 
A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

• 
The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

• 
Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

• 
Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

• 
Translational or application-oriented research.

• 
Interdisciplinary collaboration.

• 
Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

• 
Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

• 
Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

• 
Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

• 
Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

• 
The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

• 
Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

• 
Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

• 
Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

• 
Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

• 
Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.
